description: Audits a website URL or domain for AI crawler access (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt presence, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and Google Lighthouse 13.5 Agentic Browsing (/.well-known/ai-catalog.json ARD 1.0). Use this tool first when diagnosing why a site is omitted or misquoted by ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude. Do not use this tool to extract full-page Markdown content (use extract_byte0_markdown instead) or to generate static manifest files (use generate_ai_manifests instead). Read-only network check; requires no API key.

url.description: Fully qualified HTTPS URL or bare domain name to audit (e.g., "https://stripe.com/pricing" or "example.com"). Defaults to HTTPS if scheme is omitted.

name: audit_ai_readiness
title: Audit Website AI Crawler & Lighthouse 13.5 Readiness
